unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 11 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.3 - THEME 2: CLASSROOM LIFE & LEARNING

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will work on the significance of teamwork and collaboration, global collaboration projects, and the challenges for them. First, they will look for examples of successful teamwork and global projects, noting benefits and obstacles. Then, in groups, they present them in the classroom. Then, they will reflect on their own experience individually through a report by discussing what worked well and what challenged them during the process. The report will be ended with strategies they will propose to improve collaboration in different teams. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''classroom life and learning with its components such as importance of teamwork and collaboration; global collaboration projects; challenges for teamwork and collaboration'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school may know what importance of teamwork and collaboration; global collaboration projects; challenges for teamwork and collaboration mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''classroom life and learning'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''classroom life and learning with its components such as importance of teamwork and collaboration; global collaboration projects; challenges for teamwork and collaboration'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To describe and talk about the importance of teamwork and collaboration and challenges for teamwork and collaboration in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Teamwork Challenge Students work in groups of three to complete a group of tasks related to the theme. Each group member takes turns and the next student cannot start their task until the previous one is successfully completed. Tasks include matching vocabulary with definitions, describing visuals by using target vocabulary or filling in blanks with correct terms. After each task, the student shows their answer to the teacher for being approved. If it is correct, the next student continues. The group that finishes all tasks first wins. In the end, students share how they felt during the activity, and the teacher and classmates provide feedback on the use of language with the target vocabulary, grammar, creativity, and fluency. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To recognise the importance of teamwork and collaboration and challenges for teamwork and collaboration in English by using the target vocabulary. Activity 1: Word Match Challenge The teacher creates a digital puzzle game with the target vocabulary. Each group takes turns and one student drags the Turkish word to match its English meaning at a time. The group works together to complete the puzzle as fast as possible. The group that finishes in the shortest time wins. After the game, students write about their experience, such as ''We worked as a team'' or ''Collaboration helped us solve the puzzle''. They share their sentences with the class, and the teacher gives feedback on their teamwork and effort. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
